description: Eight composite patients — one session spans multiple CCS domains. Merged order stacks at play time.

cases.title: Elena — Neuro & Weakness
cases.briefingNote: One patient, four weakness presentations you would otherwise drill as separate CCS cases.
cases.objective: Stabilize and work up progressive weakness across neuromuscular differentials — MG, GBS, and mimics.
cases.chiefComplaint: Progressive weakness over weeks — ptosis, limb fatigability, and dyspnea on exertion.

cases.title: James — Cardiopulmonary Acute
cases.briefingNote: Chest pain and dyspnea in one admission — cardio + pulmonary orders without switching patients.
cases.objective: Evaluate chest pain and dyspnea with overlapping cardiac and pulmonary pathways.
cases.chiefComplaint: Substernal chest pressure and worsening shortness of breath over 24 hours.

cases.title: Maria — GI & Abdomen
cases.briefingNote: Four abdominal-pain CCS variants merged — efficient surgical / medical / OB-GYN screening.
cases.objective: Diagnose and manage abdominal pain across surgical, inflammatory, and obstructive etiologies.
cases.chiefComplaint: Progressive abdominal pain with nausea — location and character evolve during the stay.

cases.title: David — Neuro Headache & AMS
cases.briefingNote: Headache and AMS threads in one neuro admission — SAH, meningitis, and mass lesions.
cases.objective: Rule out life-threatening headache and AMS causes before symptomatic treatment.
cases.chiefComplaint: Worst headache of life with intermittent confusion and photophobia.

cases.title: Aisha — Women's & GU
cases.briefingNote: Pelvic and urinary complaints in one reproductive-age patient — OB, GU, and STI overlap.
cases.objective: Evaluate pelvic pain and urinary symptoms with pregnancy and infection rule-outs.
cases.chiefComplaint: Lower abdominal and pelvic pain with dysuria for several days.

cases.title: Robert — MSK Pain Marathon
cases.briefingNote: Knee, back, and leg pain in one patient — ortho, neuro, and vascular screens combined.
cases.objective: Differentiate mechanical, inflammatory, vascular, and neurologic limb and spine pain.
cases.chiefComplaint: Knee swelling after a fall, with new leg pain and progressive low back stiffness.

cases.title: Sophie — Fever, Rash & ID
cases.briefingNote: Fever and rash variants in one admission — meningococcemia, viral exanthem, and drug reaction.
cases.objective: Stabilize febrile rash and identify infectious vs allergic etiologies.
cases.chiefComplaint: Fever, diffuse rash, and lethargy worsening over 48 hours.

cases.title: Marcus — Psych & Behavior
cases.briefingNote: Psychiatric presentations with mandatory medical and AMS rule-outs in one encounter.
cases.objective: Assess anxiety and depression while excluding organic AMS and substance causes.
cases.chiefComplaint: Panic attacks, low mood, and episodes of confusion — family worried about safety.
